identity.name: RM 055 Bubba Watson
identity.one_liner: A heavily skeletonized manual-wind tonneau developed with golfer Bubba Watson, following the architecture of Richard Mille's earlier RM 038 tourbillon.

narrative.story: The RM 055 was developed with professional golfer Bubba Watson, extending Richard Mille's roster of athlete partnerships beyond tennis and Formula 1 into golf. Its titanium baseplate and bridges are treated with a black PVD and Titalyt coating and cut down to extreme skeletonization, following the visual language Richard Mille established with the earlier RM 038 tourbillon rather than introducing a new case architecture.
narrative.collector_notes: Case color (black, grey, or white titanium) is the primary differentiator across RM 055 examples on the secondary market; movement finishing is consistent regardless of case tone.
